description: Time-series forecast (auto ETS / Holt-Winters) — Forecast the next values of any time series offline. data= comma-separated numbers oldest first (4-500 points). Optional: horizon= steps ahead (1-60, default 6), season= period length (12 monthly, 7 daily, 4 quarterly, 24 hourly; auto-detected from autocorrelation when omitted, season=0 turns it off), method=auto|naive|ses|linear|holt|holt-winters (auto = lowest AIC), confidence= interval percent (default 95). Returns point forecasts with lower/upper prediction intervals, chosen model + smoothing parameters, trend direction, in-sample MAE/RMSE/MAPE and a model comparison table. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_forecast
